model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of different llama models with varying numbers of completions. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 20 to 28, with tick labels spaced by increments of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, ranges from 0.7 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced by increments of 0.02. A solid blue line represents the Llama-3B model, starting at approximately 0.78 at k=20 and increasing to approximately 0.8 at k=28. A dashed green line represents the Llama-3B + FT model, beginning at approximately 0.60 at k=20 and ascending to approximately 0.68 at k=28.  A solid light blue line illustrates the Llama-1B model, initiating at approximately 0.42 at k=20 and reaching a value of approximately 0.60 at k=28. Finally, a dotted green line depicts the Llama-1B + FT model, starting at approximately 0.40 at k=20 and rising to approximately 0.57 at k=28.
